# Cornelian Executive Interiors

> Luxury interior design and build firm serving Noida and Delhi NCR. Turnkey residential and commercial interiors, bespoke furniture, modular kitchens, custom consoles & cabinets, and original CHIITRA wall art.

## Key facts
- Location: Noida, Delhi NCR, India
- Areas served: Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad
- Services: turnkey interior design, interior construction & fit-out, modular kitchen, bespoke furniture, custom consoles & cabinets, commissioned CHIITRA wall art
- Model: item-wise transparent quoting, in-house workshop and art studio, no middlemen
- Contact: +91 97201 30734 · cornelianexecutiveinteriors@gmail.com
